integrity: The proof uses the normalized spherical addition kernel, direct finite-cyclic Fourier diagonalization and exact residue counting; the standalone checker independently tests matrix eigenvectors without replacing the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree evaluation on two equal-size orthogonal regular polygons in the unit three-sphere only; no claims for mixed degree bands, arbitrary unequal arrangements, or independent verification. Bounded originality comparison remains open to an older equivalent group-Fourier formulation.
title: Complete spherical-harmonic sampling spectra on orthogonal regular circles
